scenes.title: A Lucky Ticket
scenes.summary: Denis feels he has won a lucky ticket with Katya as their romance ignites, and the next morning he begs her not to run away when she worries things are moving too fast.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Breakfast at Senya's
scenes.summary: Senya and his wife Marina tease Denis and Katya in the apartment kitchen and invite them to sit down for breakfast together as a new couple.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: The Video from Riga
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya discover an online video showing head chef German violently attacking a man in Riga, and Chef Barinov recognizes his Latvian colleague Markus in the clip.

scenes.title: Latvia's Blacklist
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Senya, Fedya, and Kostya that German got a suspended sentence and mandatory psychiatric treatment in Riga after attacking a fellow cook over a waitress.

scenes.title: The Watermelon Shark
scenes.summary: Katya rushes over to Denis asking for watermelon pulp for a customer's order, only to find that Denis has carved the whole watermelon into a playful shark to cheer her up.

scenes.title: A Warning for Vika
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich shows Vika the video of German beating a man in Riga to warn her that German is dangerous, but Vika accuses Barinov of jealousy and German offers to explain everything.

scenes.title: Talking to Nagiyev
scenes.summary: After failing to convince Vika, Viktor Petrovich interrupts Dmitry Nagiyev in the dining room to warn him that German is a snake and shows him the Riga fight video.

scenes.title: An Old Story
scenes.summary: Nagiyev laughs at Barinov's video because German already spun a tale about the other cook stealing his wife and money, leaving Viktor Petrovich humiliated.

scenes.title: Don't Be a Pushover
scenes.summary: Katya scolds Senya and Fedya for goofing off with a fish in the kitchen, and when Denis tries to calm her down with pet names, she angrily tells him to stop acting like a doormat.

scenes.title: Mysterious Pills
scenes.summary: While Fedya proposes an absurd plan to edit the fight video, Kostya notices that German constantly takes mysterious pills, inspiring Chef Barinov to investigate the medication.

scenes.title: The Hot Knife and the Dill
scenes.summary: While Senya distracts German in the kitchen with a heated knife handle, Barinov and Fedya sneak into the office to inspect German's pills and nearly get caught.

scenes.title: A Strong Sedative
scenes.summary: Fedya becomes blissfully drowsy and giggly from swallowing German's powerful sedative pill, and Chef Barinov realizes that depriving German of his medication will make him snap.

scenes.title: Advice from Senya
scenes.summary: Denis tells Senya that Katya refused to stay over because she thinks he is a pushover, so Senya advises him to act like a dominant alpha male before immediately obeying his own wife Marina.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Ainura's Confession
scenes.summary: Head cleaner Ainura tries to shield German by telling Vika a ridiculous story about being German's ex-lover, but accidentally reveals that German locked Nagiyev inside the Halloween coffin.

scenes.title: A Promise of Revenge
scenes.summary: Realizing that German locked Nagiyev in the coffin and only pretended to save her job to win her trust, a furious Vika joins Chef Barinov's plot while Denis bosses Katya around.

scenes.title: A Trap for German
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov explains his three-step plan to swap German's sedatives, lure him to Vika's apartment, and interrupt him at the peak of passion, and Vika invites German over for dinner.

scenes.title: An Interrupted Dinner
scenes.summary: At Vika's apartment, German drinks the spiked wine and passionately prepares dinner with her until a fake emergency call from the restaurant forces him to leave immediately.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Be Yourself
scenes.summary: While Senya impatiently waits to eat dinner, Katya arrives late and confronts Denis outside for suddenly acting like an arrogant tough guy instead of his natural self.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: In the Office Without Pills
scenes.summary: German rushes to the restaurant only to learn that Nagiyev has already left, and Vika arrives pretending to comfort him in his office before slipping out right on cue.

scenes.title: Goodbye, German
scenes.summary: Barinov sends the Latvian cook Markus into the office to provoke German into another brawl, forcing German to resign immediately to avoid prison while Denis reflectively chooses honesty.
